neighbours.label: Spread across a whole area: the word that distributes something over an entire space or set (scattered around, throughout, the whole world, any), vs a single fixed location
fire: After the storm, broken branches lay scattered around the entire campus.
The disease spread quickly throughout the valley during the dry summer.
Hundreds of tiny shrines are dotted around the hills above the village.
Rumours of the scandal circulated throughout the ministry within a week.
Old fishing huts are scattered around the shores of the lake.
Posters for the concert were pasted up throughout the town centre.
Wild orchids grow scattered around the forest floor in early spring.
The smell of smoke drifted throughout the building for days.
quiet: After the storm, a broken branch lay beside the library steps.
The disease appeared first in a farm near the valley during the dry summer.
A tiny shrine stands at the top of the hill above the village.
Rumours of the scandal reached the minister's office within a week.
An old fishing hut stands on the north shore of the lake.
A poster for the concert was pasted up by the station entrance.
A single wild orchid grows beneath the oak tree in early spring.
The smell of smoke stayed in the kitchen for days.
